clue.text: Sounds like flower place found by Lemuel

indicators.note: the clue says the flower word is only to be heard, so its spelling changes

parts.note: a lily is a flower
to place something is to put it

explanation.surface: Someone describes a horticultural spot that a man named Lemuel stumbled upon.
explanation.walkthrough: Lemuel Gulliver, of Swift's Gulliver's Travels, was shipwrecked on the island of tiny people; the definition leans on that book.
explanation.definitionFit: Gulliver, whose first name is Lemuel, lands on this island of tiny people in Swift's novel.

clue.text: Repeat Caesar's journey with his hellish companion

parts.note: iter is Latin, Caesar's language, for a journey or march
in Julius Caesar, Antony speaks of Caesar's spirit 'with Ate by his side come hot from hell'

explanation.surface: Caesar's march is retraced alongside his infernal companion.
explanation.walkthrough: Ate is the Greek goddess of mischief and ruin.
explanation.definitionFit: To say or do again; a formal synonym.

clue.text: Plant for one existing on past art, some say

parts.note: one who lives is a liver

indicators.note: the word for past art is only heard, so its spelling changes

parts.note: wert is the old past form of art, as in thou art and thou wert

explanation.surface: A plant thrives on old artworks, according to some.
explanation.definitionFit: A primitive green non-flowering plant related to mosses.

clue.text: Capital H for this Louisiana county

parts.note: Paris is the capital of France

explanation.surface: A capital letter H stands for a district in Louisiana.
explanation.walkthrough: Louisiana's equivalent of a county is called by the same word as a church district.
explanation.definitionFit: Louisiana divides itself into these civil districts instead of counties.

clue.text: Personal appearance of Trollope's doctor said to cause irritation

indicators.note: the doctor's name is only heard, so its final letter falls away

parts.note: Doctor Thorne is a novel by Anthony Trollope
appearing in person is appearing in the flesh

explanation.surface: Trollope's doctor turns up in person and becomes a nuisance.
explanation.definitionFit: A persistent source of annoyance, from St Paul's phrase in Corinthians.

clue.text: Bird questions identity of a bear?

definitions.text: Bird questions identity of a bear?

parts.words: Bird questions identity of a bear?
parts.note: said aloud, the bird's name is like asking 'Who? Pooh?', querying which bear A. A. Milne's Pooh is

explanation.surface: A bird puzzles over just which bear it is looking at.
explanation.definitionFit: A crested pinkish bird of Europe and Africa whose name, spoken, is like the question 'Who, Pooh?'.

clue.text: Printed notice supplied by worker on account

indicators.note: in a down entry, one piece sits on top of the other

parts.note: a hand is a worker
a bill is an account

explanation.surface: A worker presents a printed notice with the bill.
explanation.definitionFit: A small printed advertisement or flyer distributed by hand.

clue.text: Accurate' recipes for a change.

indicators.note: the letters of recipes are changed into a different order

explanation.surface: A cook tries exact recipes as a novelty.
explanation.definitionFit: Exact and correct in every detail.

clue.text: Values new ties with fellow workers

indicators.note: the letters of ties are made new, rearranged

parts.note: mates are workmates, colleagues

explanation.surface: Colleagues appraise some new neckwear.
explanation.definitionFit: Judges the worth of; assesses roughly.

clue.text: Parson Edward's retreat in Colorado

indicators.note: to retreat is to go backwards, so the two pieces before it are read back to front

parts.note: a parson is a clergyman, addressed as Rev (Reverend)
Ned is a pet form of Edward

explanation.surface: A clergyman named Edward has a hideaway in the Rocky Mountain state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retreat' looks like a noun for a holiday house but turns REVNED round to make the city.
explanation.definitionFit: The state capital of Colorado, a city found in that state.

clue.text: Ten Roman characters on the, shelf perhaps

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are treated as loose characters to be set out again in a new order

explanation.surface: Ten Roman figures stand on a shelf, possibly as decorations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters' is the anagram signal: the letters of TEN ROMAN are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A decorative knick-knack is typically displayed sitting on a shelf or mantelpiece.

clue.text: We may be privately protected in this town

definitions.text: We may be privately protected in this town

parts.words: We may be privately protected in this town
parts.note: privately means by privates, ordinary soldiers, who guard a fortified military town

explanation.surface: A resident remarks that their town is guarded by private security.
explanation.definitionFit: A town with a permanent body of troops stationed to defend it.

clue.text: Element of hesitation after opening of the music

indicators.note: the hesitation sound is placed after the musical piece

parts.note: the first bar of a score is bar I, bar one
um is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A pause comes just after the music starts.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'opening of the music' as BAR I, the first bar, written with a Roman numeral one.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft silvery-white chemical element, atomic number 56, used in medical X-ray meals.

clue.text: It's displayed by some London fruiterers

definitions.text: It's displayed by some London fruiterers

indicators.note: the fruit is shown inside the run of letters of the words some London

explanation.surface: A fruit is on show at certain London greengrocers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'displayed by' hides the fruit inside 'soME LONdon'; the whole clue also describes it.
explanation.definitionFit: A large juicy fruit sold by greengrocers, so the whole clue describes it.

clue.text: Mica for Mikhail?

definitions.meaning: a silicate mineral that splits into thin sheets
a typical Russian first name, standing for a Moscow resident

explanation.definitionFit: A common pale mica mineral; also a native of Moscow, such as someone named Mikhail.

clue.text: Severe but fashionable Church Father

parts.note: in means fashionable, in vogue
Clement of Rome or Clement of Alexandria, early Fathers of the Church

explanation.surface: A stylish early churchman who is nonetheless stern.
explanation.definitionFit: Inclement weather is harsh and stormy, so severe is a synonym.

clue.text: Like one pursued by Yellow- Dog Dingo

definitions.text: Like one pursued by Yellow- Dog Dingo

parts.words: Like one pursued by Yellow- Dog Dingo
parts.note: in Kipling's Just So story, Yellow-Dog Dingo chases Old Man Kangaroo, a pouched mammal

explanation.surface: Resembling the hunted animal in a Kipling tale.
explanation.definitionFit: Pouched like a kangaroo, the animal Kipling's dingo chases.

clue.text: Longest strike of nocturnal workers

parts.note: strike means a clock's chiming, and the longest is twelve strokes in the night; workers are the clock's works

explanation.surface: Night-shift staff stage their longest walkout.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelve o'clock at night, when a clock chimes its most strokes.

clue.text: Spectacle includes plot revision wherein the star shines

indicators.note: one word takes the other inside it

parts.note: a spectacle is a sight

indicators.note: the letters of plot are revised, reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: A show contains a rewritten storyline in which the lead actor dazzles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'includes' puts POTL (the rearranged PLOT, from 'revision') inside SIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: On stage, a beam of light picks out the leading performer.

clue.text: Transgress an unfashionable measure

parts.note: out means out of fashion
a step is a measure, a course of action

explanation.surface: To break the rules by taking an outmoded action.
explanation.definitionFit: To overstep, go beyond proper limits.

clue.text: Affliction associated with the Maltese

definitions.meaning: a burden or trial one must bear
the Maltese emblem with four V-shaped arms

explanation.definitionFit: A trouble one must bear is a burden like Christ's; the Maltese emblem is an eight-pointed one.

clue.text: In which cuts may be made by a key worker

definitions.text: In which cuts may be made by a key worker

parts.words: In which cuts may be made by a key worker
parts.note: a typist, working at keys, cuts a waxed sheet for duplicating

explanation.surface: Sounds like an important employee imposing budget cuts.
explanation.definitionFit: A waxed duplicating sheet once cut by typewriter keys for copying.

clue.text: Entrap? Could be

indicators.note: suggests the word before might become something else when its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Wondering whether something is a trap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Could be' rearranges ENTRAP; the answer is also an old verb meaning to ensnare.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaic verb meaning to lure or ensnare, so the clue word itself defines it.

clue.text: Easy to pick the soft one

definitions.text: Easy to pick the soft one

parts.words: Easy to pick the soft one
parts.note: the easy choice is called the soft one, and a choice is something you pick

explanation.surface: It is simple to choose the gentle one.
explanation.definitionFit: A choice or alternative; the easy way out is called the soft one.

clue.text: Riches song-writers make for what they make?

parts.note: songwriters compose tunes

explanation.surface: Composers earn wealth from the songs they write.
explanation.definitionFit: Large sums of wealth, which successful composers earn.

clue.text: Rouse interest in scheming

definitions.meaning: noun sense: secret plotting or conspiracy

explanation.definitionFit: To fascinate or arouse curiosity; also secret plotting.

clue.text: Charming high-born chap!

parts.note: the pantomime hero of Cinderella has the surname Charming and is royal

explanation.surface: A delightful aristocratic gentleman.
explanation.definitionFit: A son of royalty, and in the fairy tale the hero is called this before the word Charming.

clue.text: Rye, for example, to 'assist in balance of trade

definitions.meaning: a town that used to be a harbour, as Rye in East Sussex was before silting
to send goods abroad for sale, which improves a country's balance of trade

explanation.walkthrough: Rye is a town in East Sussex, once one of the Cinque Ports but now inland: a port no longer.
explanation.definitionFit: Rye in Sussex was a harbour town before its sea silted up, so a former one; goods sold abroad help the trade balance.

clue.text: State capital for Vietnamese leader? No, Berg opera

parts.note: Ho Chi Minh, leader of North Vietnam
taken as written
Lulu is an opera by Alban Berg

explanation.surface: A question about a Vietnamese leader is answered by naming a modern opera instead.
explanation.definitionFit: Hawaii's capital city, the seat of a US state government.
